design: Retrospective historical supplementation; dates and prices were already inspected. This is a frozen calculation specification, NOT an ex-ante preregistration or prediction.
selection: GS is a newly documented historical conference case with readable body and mature windows, not a replacement for the original AMD Nov10 case. Q3 rechecks a case preserved in the inherited Nov8 report. Selection by evidence availability introduces selection bias.
baseline: Last regular-session close strictly before documented event time; after-close release uses same-date close. For GS conflicting timezone labels both fall within the session, so previous-session close is unchanged.
windows: Event date close (unavailable as a post-event endpoint for after-close releases); next, fifth and twentieth trading-session closes AFTER the calendar release/conference date. All cumulative from baseline, not consecutive daily returns. Calendar offsets and explicit endpoints are stored per event.
price_convention: USD Close column, source split-adjusted; excludes cash dividends. Do not mix Adj.Close or unadjusted pre-split prices. No intraday or total-return claim.
formula: 100*(endpoint_close/baseline_close-1); relative_pp = AMD_return_pct - SOXX_return_pct. No beta adjustment or causal abnormal-return model.
benchmark: SOXX semiconductor sector ETF. Matched dates and price convention; includes AMD exposure and cannot remove issuer weight, beta, macro or concurrent-news effects.
cutoff_rule: Only completed regular-session closes at or before cutoff. Future/missing endpoints remain null; never substitute a shorter window. New York market close converted to UTC for validation.
interpretation: Historical association only; no ex-ante forecast score, isolated Q&A response, attention prediction or event causality. Report negative results and confounders. A single retrospectively selected issuer cannot establish H1-H7 statistically.
